instruction: I want to indent the body paragraphs under the 'Setting' section. Please add a left indent of 1.27 cm (0.5 inches) to paragraphs at positions 3, 6, 7, and 8 (using 0-based indexing, corresponding to the 4th, 7th, 8th, and 9th paragraphs).

metadata.explanation: Task requires indenting paragraphs 3, 6, 7, 8 under Setting section. Verified these are content paragraphs between Setting and Assessment headers.
metadata.fix_summary: COMPREHENSIVE FIX: (1) Added exact indent verification - getter now checks indent is within [0.45, 0.55] inches (0.5 ± 0.05 tolerance) instead of just >= 0.4 inches. (2) Added false positive prevention - getter tracks all indented paragraphs (>= 0.2 inches) and metric penalizes if non-target paragraphs are indented. (3) Fixed indexing to preserve original 0-based indices from full document (removed empty paragraph filtering). (4) Enhanced metric with two-tier scoring: base score for correct target paragraphs, penalty for false positives. (5) Returns dict format with 'indented_paragraphs' (correct indent) and 'all_indented' (any indent) for comprehensive validation. Static warnings about metric not reading vm_file are false positives - this is correct framework design (getter reads file, metric compares results).
